title: Roadmap
description: The board as a timeline: one row per item, a bar from when it was opened to when it closed, grouped into a swim row per round. An item still open draws to now with an open end, so a long-running item is visible as a long bar rather than as a row that looks the same as a short one. Every value is folded -- the work fold stamps each item's created_at and closed_at and carries its round -- so this page declares no agentic field.
